description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single ranged attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Quick Cast] and [Dual Handgun Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Dual Handgun Mode
description.text: Keeps track of the number of Machinist abilities used (0~4), grants [Dual Handgun Critical Chance] to the user after using a Machinist ability, casts Sparked Munitions when removed
